Hello,

Thank you for forwarding this. Please do not pay it and do not click the link in that message.

It reads like a phishing attempt. Real DHL duty notices are tied to a waybill number you can check yourself on dhl.com, they do not come as a payment button in an image, and the sender address and reply address on this one do not belong to DHL. The "Hammer Miner Thor P2 Returned" line is the kind of detail scammers add to make a message look legitimate.

HeliumDeploy will never ask you to pay duties through a link sent in an email. If a genuine duty charge ever applies to a shipment of ours, the carrier raises it directly with you against your tracking number.

If you did already enter card details, contact your bank and have the card blocked.

I have passed this to a colleague so we can verify with DHL whether anything is actually in transit under your name. The team is offline until Monday at 10am Eastern and will reply to this email once they have checked. If you have an order number with us, send it in your reply and that will speed things up.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
